value.rationale: It answers a meaningful new part of the explicitly formulated higher-skeletal-range question: a full all-dimensional natural obstruction, sharp threshold in this canonical family and 0.672437... upper density for universal codimensions. Prior motivating article had a single low-dimensional simplex example and fixed low-j product counterexamples, not the linear-j obstruction. The exact integer threshold and second-order displacement are mathematically usable; no universal optimality is claimed.
